searchTerms.title: Company name search terms
searchTerms.description: One or more company/business names or keywords to search for in Tonga's Business Entities Registry (e.g. "Bank"). Each term returns every matching entity (companies, overseas companies, business names, business licences, foreign certificates).

corpIds.title: Entity IDs (direct profile lookup)
corpIds.description: Optional: Tonga Registry "CorpId" GUIDs (as seen in a prior run's output, or in an EntityProfile.aspx?id=... URL) to fetch the full profile directly, without searching by name.

fetchProfiles.title: Fetch full profile for each search result
fetchProfiles.description: When on (default), also fetches the full entity profile (addresses, directors, shareholders, filing history) for every search match. When off, only the lightweight search-result fields are returned (faster, fewer requests).

entityTypeId.title: Filter by entity type
entityTypeId.description: Optional: restrict search results to one entity type.

maxResultsPerTerm.title: Max results per search term
maxResultsPerTerm.description: Maximum number of matching entities to return for each search term. Common words can match many entities -- this caps how many are pulled.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many search terms / entity IDs to process in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
